images.name: hero
images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original photography for a premium architecture and interior design studio website.
Style/medium: photorealistic editorial architecture magazine photograph, richly textured natural surfaces, plausible precise architectural geometry, cinematic yet honest photographic depth, no render sheen. Landscape 3:2 composition, full room scene, straight verticals, professional architectural photography.
Constraints: no people, no text, no logos, no watermark.
Primary request: a warm sophisticated living room with a curved ivory sofa and a round travertine coffee table, dark walnut joinery, huge tall arched windows with Paris and Barcelona Mediterranean architectural detailing. A sculptural pendant hangs naturally within the room, and an olive tree is visible through a window.
Lighting/mood: beautiful strong side sunlight and dimensional shadows, welcoming and composed, sunlit atmosphere.
Color palette: restrained cream, olive, tobacco brown.
Materials/textures: tactile ivory upholstery, porous pale travertine, walnut wood grain, quietly textured cream walls. Full scene with room to breathe and furniture integrated into the architecture.
